# Pinned Foundry opening advancement

The JSON is copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/blob/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/foundry/structure.json

The manifest records source path and SHA-256. Only the icon item key is

registered by this port. The shared Java trigger fixture is retained under
`tests/fixtures/smeltery_opening/`.
